blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Streaming video understanding is becoming increasingly important for real-world interactive systems. Such systems must be proactive for natural and useful human interaction: they should respond as soon as sufficient evidence becomes available while avoiding premature, redundant, or incorrect responses. We present BLIP-Live, a framework unifying data, metrics, harness, and training around a shared formulation of proactivity as effective causal response decisions balancing the two competing objectives of responding vs silence. First, we construct BLIP-Live-780K dataset containing human annotations of proactive response content and timing, which defines this desired behavior. We then propose PAUC-F, a metric to effectively measure our desired proactive behavior. PAUC-F combines existing response timeliness metrics with firing precision to reward early useful responses without rewarding excessive firing. With our desired behavior defined and measurable, we finally investigate model-agnostic inference harnesses that draw out proactive streaming capabilities of offline vision language models (VLMs), together with training pipelines that learn to further improve their proactive responsiveness. Across both settings, we find that combinations of sliding visual windows, online interaction memory, and structured response outputs consistently yield strongest proactive performance. Our experiments result in two models, with our BLIP-Live-Qwen model achieving state-of-the-art performance across four proactive streaming benchmarks, with gains up to 44% over baselines and outperforming multiple closed API models. Our code and data will be released publicly.
blocks.zh: 对现实世界互动系统而言,视频的流畅理解越来越重要。 这种系统必须积极主动地进行自然和有益的人类互动:一旦获得足够的证据,它们就应立即作出反应,同时避免过早、重复或不正确的反应。 我们提出《BLIP-Live》,这是一个统一数据、衡量标准、利用和培训的框架,围绕的是共同制定积极性,作为有效的因果反应决定,平衡两个相互竞争的目标,即对沉默作出反应。 首先,我们构建了BLIP-Live-780K数据集,包含人类对主动反应内容和时间的说明,它定义了这种所期望的行为. 然后,我们提议PAUC-F, 一个衡量我们所期望的主动行为的标准。 PAUC-F结合了现有的反应及时性测量和射击精度来奖励早期有用的反应而不会奖励过度射击. 随着我们所期望的行为的界定和可测量,我们最终调查了模型-不可知推论利用,这些推论引出线下视觉语言模型(VLM)的主动流出能力,以及学习进一步提高其主动反应能力的培训管道. 在这两种情况下,我们发现滑动的视觉窗口、在线互动内存和结构化的响应产出的组合,始终产生最强的主动性。 我们的实验产生了两个模型,我们的BLIP-Live-Quen模型在四个主动的流线基准中实现了最先进的性能,其收益比基线最高可达44%,超过多个封闭的API模型。 我们的代码和数据将公开发布。

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en:
Proactive streaming video agents must learn not only what to say, but also when to say it , and when to remain silent ( Wang et al., 2026 ; Wang et al., 2025b ) .
This differs from offline video question-answering, where queries are immediately followed by responses.
Streaming agents observe videos incrementally (causal), and at each frame decide whether to respond or remain silent for a query provided at an earlier time ( Chen et al., 2024a ; Yu et al., 2025 ) .
This causal firing decision presents a key challenge: a correct response is unhelpful if it arrives too late or is repeated too often ( Wang et al., 2026 ) .
Effective proactivity requires balancing response timeliness with firing precision.

主动流传的视频代理不仅必须学会如何说话,而且必须学会何时说话,何时保持沉默(Wang等,2026;Wang等,2025b.).

有效的主动性需要平衡反应的及时性和发射的精确性。

blocks.en:
We first construct BLIP-Live-780K, a large-scale dataset of proactive responses built through automated proactive question-answer generation followed by comprehensive human verification.
In contrast to existing proactive streaming datasets ( Table 1 ), BLIP-Live-780K provides human verified response content and intervals, providing explicit human supervision on when to remain silent.
Next, we propose PAUC-F, an evaluation metric that captures both timeliness and firing precision in proactive streaming model responses.
Prior metrics such as PAUC ( Wang et al., 2025b ) and ESTP-F1 ( Yu et al., 2025 ) separately measure individual aspects of the proactive streaming task, leaving room for models to game these metrics with undesirable traits (see Figure 2 and Table 4 ).
Our proposed PAUC-F, retains PAUC’s quality-weighted timeliness and balances it with response precision.

与现有的主动流体数据集(表1)不同,BLIP-Live-780K提供了经人类验证的响应内容和间隔,为何时保持沉默提供了明确的人类监督.
其次,我们提议采用PAUC-F这一评价指标,在积极主动的流线模型反应中既能及时又能准确发射。
以往的衡量标准,如PAUC(Wang等人,2025b)和ESTP-F1(Yu等人,2025年)分别衡量主动流线任务的个别方面,为模型以不理想的特质对这些衡量标准进行游戏留有余地(见图2和表4)。
我们提议的PAUC-F,保留PAUC质量加权的及时性,并精确地平衡反应.

blocks.en:
With desired behavior defined and measurable, next we investigate harness designs and training pipelines that improve proactive behavior in VLMs.
Existing works explore proactivity with learned activation models ( Wang et al., 2025a ) , hand-crafted harness designs ( Yao et al., 2026 ) , learned response decision tokens ( Chen et al., 2024a ; Li et al., 2026 ) , and response policy optimization ( Wang et al., 2025c ; Wang et al., 2026 ) .
We introduce a model-agnostic harness tuning strategy to elicit proactivity in VLMs.
Our selected harness combines a sliding visual window, interaction memory, and structured decision states.
The same interface then supports efficient teacher-forced training with our datasets, further improving proactive responsiveness in VLMs, and resulting in two models, BLIP-Live-Gemma and BLIP-Live-Qwen.
Our BLIP-Live-Qwen model achieves state-of-the-art performance across four proactive streaming benchmarks, outperforming multiple closed source models as well.

现有作品探索采用已学到的活化模型(Wang等人,2025a),手工制作的接绳设计(Yao等人,2026),已学会的反应决定符号(Chen等人,2024a; 李等,2026年),并优化应对政策(王等,2025c;王等,2026.

我们的BLIP-Live-Quen模式在四个积极主动的流出基准中实现了最先进的业绩,也超过了多个封闭源模式。

blocks.en: We summarize our key contributions as follows: 1. BLIP-Live-780K Dataset: A high-quality proactive streaming dataset for training built through automated generation of proactive question–response pairs, followed by comprehensive human review and filtering to ensure accurate response content and timing annotations. 2. PAUC-F Metric: Evaluation metric designed to measure proactive understanding in VLMs that captures both response timeliness and firing precision. 3. Inference Harness: Model-agnostic harness tuning and calibration that adapts offline VLMs for proactive responding under streaming style inference. 4. Training Framework: Efficient training pipeline resulting in BLIP-Live-Gemma and BLIP-Live-Qwen models that yield relative improvements up to 44% over prior baselines across benchmarks.

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en:
Proactive responsiveness is tackled under two key directions: inference harness and training pipeline.
Harness design involves response gates, event detection, and long-context memory management ( Wang et al., 2025a ; Qian et al., 2025 ; Ding et al., 2025 ; Azad et al., 2026 ; Zhang et al., 2026a ; Tian et al., 2026 ; Yao et al., 2025 ; Zheng et al., 2026 ; Yao et al., 2026 ) , but its role is mainly streaming setting adaptation, overlooking direct optimization for proactivity.
Proactive behavior is handled mostly in model through response decision states ( Chen et al., 2024a ; Xia et al., 2026 ; Li et al., 2026 ) , implicit signals in interleaved video-text data ( Wang et al., 2025c ; Yang et al., 2025 ) , and reinforcement learning ( Wang et al., 2026 ) .
In contrast, our proposed harness is model agnostic and tuned specifically for proactivity, while the same interface extends to supervision when training data is available and transfers across model families rather than committing to fixed architectures.
blocks.zh:
在两个关键方向下处理积极主动的反应:利用推断和培训管道。
谐音设计涉及响应门,事件探测,和长通文字记忆管理(王等,2025a;Q等,2025;丁等,2025;阿扎德等,2026;张等,2026a;天等,2026;姚等,2025;郑等,2026;姚等,2026),但其作用主要是流线设置适应,俯瞰直接优化促进.
主动行为大多通过反应决定状态在模型中处理(Chen等人,2024a; Xia等,2026;Li等,2026),互出视频文本数据中暗含的信号(王等,2025c;杨等,2025),并强化学习(王等,2026).
与此相反,我们提议的利用方式是模型不可知的,并特别为主动性而调整,而当培训数据和示范家庭之间的转移,而不是致力于固定结构时,同样的接口则延伸到监督。

blocks.en:
Prior works convert offline annotations from existing datasets to streaming style, often with LLM assistance. Chen et al. (2024a) reformats COIN and Ego4D narrations directly into streaming dialogues,
while Wang et al. (2025c) ; Wang et al. (2025a) use dense captioning task data to determine response timing using annotated temporal segments. Wang et al. (2026) ; Yao et al. (2025) generate dialogue from scene captions with text-only LLMs. Xia et al. (2026) ; Li et al. (2026) derive labels from a VLM at scale.
However, existing datasets suffer from poor response timing ( Wang et al., 2026 ) , affecting quality of proactive responsiveness.
In contrast, BLIP-Live-780K ensures accurate response content and timing through comprehensive human verification (see Table 1 ).
blocks.zh:
前作将已存在的数据集的离线注释转换为流体样式,常得到LLM协助. 陈等. (2024a) 重构 COIN 和 Ego4D 描述直接进入流式对话,
Wang et al. (2025c)) ; Wang等 (2025a)使用密集字幕任务数据,使用附加说明的时间段确定响应时间. 王等 (2026年); 姚等. (2025)从场景字幕生成只使用文本的 LLMs 对话框. Xia等 (2026); Li等 (2026) 从一个VLM 规模得到标签.
然而,现有数据集反应时间差(Wang等,2026年),影响了主动反应的质量.
相比之下,BLIP-Live-780K通过全面的人类核查确保准确的反应内容和时间(见表1)。

blocks.en:
Early benchmarks evaluate proactivity through targeted tasks.
OVO-Bench ( Li et al., 2025 ) introduces CRR (Clue Reveal Responding) task where the same query requires different responses at different timesteps.
StreamingBench proposes Proactive Output (PO) task that evaluates the first response occurring within ± 2 \pm 2 seconds of an annotated timestamp ( Lin et al., 2024 ) .
In contrast, later ESTP-F1 ( Yu et al., 2025 ) and PAUC ( Wang et al., 2025b ) metrics evaluate continuous interaction under true streaming settings, but both overlook firing-precision to certain extents ( Figure 2 ), motivating our proposed PAUC-F metric.
blocks.zh:
早期基准通过目标明确的任务评估积极性。
OVO-Bench(Li等,2025年)引入了CRR(Clue Reveal Response)任务,同一查询需要不同时间步的不同回复.
简化奔驰提案 主动输出(PO)任务,评价在 ± 2\pm 2 秒内出现的第一个反应,附加说明的时间戳(Lin等,2024).
相比之下,后来的ESTP-F1(Yu等人,2025年)和PAUC(Wang等人,2025年b)的度量衡评价了在正流环境下的连续相互作用,但两者都忽略了一定程度的射击精度(图2),激发了我们提议的PAUC-F度量.

blocks.en: Evolving inference harnesses is explored for general agents and offline video understanding ( Zhang et al., 2026c ; Xu and Chen, 2026 ; Zhang et al., 2026b ) , but ours is a first to demonstrate successful integration to proactive or streaming video tasks.

blocks.en: 3 The BLIP-Live-780K Dataset
blocks.zh: 3 BLIP-Live-780000K号 数据集

blocks.en:
We construct a dataset for learning proactive response behavior in streaming video tasks, containing 784,944 proactive responses across 177,789 videos.
Each video includes a user query followed by a sequence of temporally grounded natural-language responses. Our dataset uses the same source videos as LLaVA-Video-178K ( Zhang et al., 2024 ) . We employ a three-stage annotation pipeline: Stage 1: Automated Generation. Creates candidate proactive query and response sequences. Stage 2: Human Verification and Correction. Human annotators inspect generated samples and correct errors related to both response timing and content. Stage 3: Expert Quality Review. Independent PhD-level reviewers evaluate corrected annotations in batches.
Batches below acceptance threshold are returned to Stage 2 for further revision.

我们构建了一个数据集,用于在流媒体任务中学习主动反应行为,包含177,789个视频中的784,944个主动反应.
每段视频包括一个用户查询,然后是一系列基于时间的自然语言响应. 我们的数据集使用与LLaVA-Video-178K相同的源视频(张等,2024年). 我们使用一个三阶段注解管道: 第一阶段:自动生成。 创建候选的主动查询和响应序列。 第二阶段:人类核查和矫正。 人类注释者检查生成的样本并纠正与反应时间和内容有关的错误。 第3阶段:专家质量审查。 独立的博士级审评员分批评价经更正的说明。
低于验收阈值的接头被送回第二阶段作进一步修改。

blocks.en:
Note that each query can require a single or multiple responses across the video, with each response corresponding to a single frame or frame interval.
Our annotations capture both response and silent timings to encourage firing precision. Table 1 shows how compared to earlier work, our dataset is larger in scale and provides human-verified annotations for both response content and intervals.

我们的说明既记录了反应,也记录了无声的时间,以鼓励发射精确度。 表1显示与先前的工作相比,我们的数据集的规模较大,提供了经过人验证的回复内容和间隔说明。

blocks.en: Table 1: Proposed Streaming Proactive Dataset: We construct a training dataset for proactive streaming task with human-annotated content and intervals.
blocks.zh: 表1:拟议的流动数据集: 我们构建了一个培训数据集,用于以人为附加说明的内容和间隔执行积极主动的流线任务。

blocks.en:
We generate proactive interactions for a given video using a VLM in two successive stages.
First, for query generation, we provide the VLM with a single video and obtain a single video-specific user query relevant to measuring proactive responsiveness.
Next, for response generation, we provide the VLM both the video and query to obtain an ordered sequence of response or silence states. This is generated at 1 FPS, i.e. one state per second.
Response states also include the response content.
The generator receives the full video but is prompted to use only evidence available up to each response timestamp; humans then verify and correct timing and content.
blocks.zh:
我们用一个VLM连续两个阶段为给定的视频产生主动互动.
首先,对于查询生成,我们向VLM提供单一的视频,并获得单一的视频专用用户查询,与测量主动反应相关.
接下来,对于响应生成,我们提供VLM同时提供视频和查询,以获得有序的响应序列或沉默状态. 这以 1 FPS 生成,即每秒一个状态.
反应状态还包括反应内容.
生成者收到完整的视频,但被敦促只使用每个响应时间戳可用的证据;人类随后核查并正确的时间和内容.

blocks.en:
Human annotators first filter videos based on query validity, and then evaluate each response or silent state. Incorrect states are fixed, including correction of response content when necessary.
Query validity is defined as requiring only visually verifiable conditions and unambiguous answers.
Response and silent states are evaluated based on alignment with evidence present in video until the relevant timestep, and corrected accordingly.
Note that response states capture not only instantaneous events but also continuous events which involve consecutive response states over multiple timesteps.
Of the responses generated, human review modified  11% and removed  40%, while adding  28% new responses. We provide full editing and filtering statistics in Tables 3 and 3 .

查询的有效性被定义为只需要可视可核查的条件和明确答案.
对有关时间步骤之前的反应和沉默状态根据与录像中的证据保持一致的情况进行评估,并作出相应的更正。
请注意,反应状态不仅反映即时事件,而且反映连续事件,涉及多个阶段的连续反应状态。

blocks.en:
All annotators are recruited and trained by a professional video data annotation team.
We provide detailed instructions and visual examples describing our annotation requirement.
The annotated samples undergo quality control at batch level, using PhD-level expert reviewers (who designed the annotation process).
After each batch, annotation proceeds to next only if quality exceeds our required threshold.
Failing batches are returned for further review and correction.
While initial batches required one repeat cycle, later batches passed required quality directly, ascertaining that annotation process was well aligned with our specified requirement.

blocks.en: 4 PAUC-F: Proactive Streaming Evaluation Metric
blocks.zh: 4 PAUC-F:主动流出评价计量

blocks.en:
We propose PAUC-F that jointly captures answer quality, timeliness, and firing precision.
In Table 4 , humans prefer a harness optimized with this PAUC-F metric over 90% of the time.
blocks.zh:
我们提议PAUC-F 联合捕捉到质量、及时性和发射精度。
在表4中,人类更喜欢用这种PAUC-F 度量衡优化的绳子,超过90%的时间.

blocks.en: 4.1 Limitations of Prior Metrics
blocks.zh: 4.1 先前计量的限制

blocks.en:
PAUC ( Wang et al., 2025b ) and ESTP-F1 ( Yu et al., 2025 ) are two key metrics in recent literature relevant to proactivity in streaming video agents.
PAUC measures quality weighted timeliness in responses.
However, PAUC only measures recall within the gold-window. This results in responses outside of the gold-window window being discarded, and repeated responses within the window not affecting the score (see Figure 2 ).
Similar observations are noted in MMDuet2 ( Wang et al., 2026 ) , where removing the repetition reward increases PAUC scores although duplicate replies increase by 4x.
ESTP-F1 addresses out-of-window firing with the addition of a precision term, but ignores redundant in-window firing and requires task-dependent timing term for recall calculation.
These two key metrics provide complementary but incomplete views, which we demonstrate in Figure 2 .
blocks.zh:
PAUC(Wang等,2025年b)和ESTP-F1(Yu等,2025年)是近代文献中与流媒体视频代理的活性相关的两个关键衡量标准.
PAUC衡量答复的质量加权及时性。
然而,PAUC只在黄金窗口内采取措施召回。 这导致金窗外的响应被丢弃,而窗口内重复响应不影响分数(见图2).
在MMDuet2(Wang等,2026年)中也注意到了类似的意见,其中去掉重复奖励提高了PAUC的分数,虽然重复答复增加了4x.
ESTP-F1通过添加精准名词来解决出窗射击,但忽略了多余的入窗射击,需要依赖任务的时间名词来计算召回.
这两个关键衡量标准提供了补充性但不完整的观点,我们在图2中表明了这一点。

blocks.en: 4.3 Metric Properties
blocks.zh: 4.3 计量属性

blocks.en:
We investigate properties of our proposed PAUC-F metric in Figure 2 and Table 4 .
First, we construct a toy experiment simulating undesired excessive firing behavior.
We use ground-truth response content and intervals to mimic models exhibiting within golden window repetitions and excessive out-of-window firing.
As observed in Figure 2 , both PAUC and ESTP-F1 fail to capture at least one of these undesired repetitive response behaviors, while PAUC-F correctly penalizes both.
This excessive firing simulation was motivated by findings in prior work where models optimized for PAUC alone exhibit such repetitive behavior in their responses ( Wang et al., 2026 ) .
blocks.zh:
我们调查图2和表4中我们提议的PAUC-F计量标准的财产。
首先,我们构建一个玩具实验 模拟不受欢迎的过度射击行为。

blocks.en:

We also conduct a human preference study involving 10 participants rating 20 samples from WEB and EGO splits of ( Wang et al., 2025b ) .

blocks.en: 5 Method
blocks.zh: 5 方法

blocks.en: In this section, we introduce our inference harness and training pipeline for streaming video tasks.
blocks.zh: 在本节中,我们介绍我们的推论手段和培训管道,用于传输视频任务。

blocks.en:
We first establish our definition of streaming inference, which is aligned with prior work ( Chen et al., 2024a ; Wang et al., 2026 ; Li et al., 2026 ) .
At time t t , a model receives a window of past video frames and a textual state capturing prior queries and responses.
In turn, the model must produce either silence or a response at the current timestamp.
The model cannot access future frames, revise an earlier response, or assign a new answer to an older timestamp.
This protocol aligns with the same prior work and allows models to understand streaming videos extending beyond model visual context and to proactively respond at any time after a user query.
blocks.zh:
我们首先确定了与先前工作相一致的流入推论的定义(Chen等,2024a; 王等, 2026; 李等, 2026).
在时间t t 中,一个模型接收了过去视频帧的窗口和一个文本状态来捕捉先前的询问和答复.
反过来,模型必须在目前的时标上产生沉默或反应.
该模型无法访问未来帧,修改更早的响应,或为更古老的时间戳指定新的答案.
此协议与之前的相同工作保持一致,并允许模型理解超出模型视觉上下文的流出视频,并在用户查询后随时主动回应.

blocks.en: We also define a streaming video model as one trained specifically to consume inputs and generate outputs in this format, as opposed to offline VLMs trained for offline video question-answering that can be adapted to this task through suitable harness design.
blocks.zh: 我们还将流相视频模型定义为一种经过专门培训的、以这种格式消耗投入和产生产出的视频模型,而不是为离线视频问答而经过培训的、可通过适当用具设计适应这项任务的离线甚高频模型。

blocks.en: 5.1 Inference Harness
blocks.zh: 5.1 推断方法

blocks.en:
Prior works often measure proactive behaviour of offline VLMs using non-streaming inference settings ( Wang et al., 2025b ; Chen et al., 2024a ; Yu et al., 2025 ) , making direct comparison to streaming models difficult.
For example, Wang et al. (2025b) evaluates offline VLMs on 5s frame chunks with responses of frame t t conditioned on frames up to t + 5 t+5 , deviating from the streaming task setting.
More recent works integrate offline VLMs with an inference harness ( Li et al., 2026 ; Wang et al., 2025a ; Yao et al., 2026 ) for evaluation under true streaming settings.
While these works hand-craft harness designs, we focus on tuning a harness, motivated by recent work on automated harness evolution ( Zhang et al., 2026c ) , to elicit stronger proactive responsiveness from an offline model.
blocks.zh:
先前的作品往往利用非流性推论环境衡量离线VLM的主动行为(Wang等,2025b; 陈等,2024a; Yu等,2025),使与流体模型的直接比较变得困难.
例如,Wang等人(2025年b)在5s帧块上对离线VLM进行评价,对帧t的响应附加了帧t条件,最高可达t+5t+5,偏离了流线任务设置.
更近期的作品将离线的VLMs与推论带相融合(Li等,2026;Wang等,2025a; 姚等,2026),为正流设置下的评价.
虽然这些手工业的用具设计,但我们侧重于调整用具,这是在最近自动化用具演化工作(张等,2026c)的推动下进行的,目的是从离线模型中引出更积极的反应。

blocks.en:
As illustrated in Figure 3 , our harness contains four key components: system prompt defining task and output schema, past frame window, memory holding prior interactions, and structured output parsing.
The underlying model is called at the desired frame rate, with dynamic inputs at each timestep conditioned on the past model responses.
blocks.zh:
如图3所示,我们的利用包含四个关键组成部分:系统即时定义任务和输出计划、过去的框架窗口、内存保持先前的相互作用以及结构化的输出解析。
基本模型按所期望的帧率调用,每个时段的动态输入以过去的模型响应为条件.

blocks.en:
We next optimize the design of its four key components.
Instead of hand-crafting these design choices, we utilize agent-assisted search to modify the harness, keeping underlying VLM model weights frozen (i.e. no model training).
The agent first proposes hypotheses for modifying one of these four components, implements relevant code changes, and evaluates on BLIP-Live-780K validation set using our PAUC-F metric.
These results guide new hypothesis creation over several rounds and the final design selection.
Each round contains ten candidate variants and we promote variants that improve our objective (PAUC-F on validation set).
Combination of complementary promoted changes is treated as a novel hypothesis for next round.
We run 10 rounds of propose-evaluate-promote cycles with a total of 100 candidate evaluations each for two different models: Gemma4-26B-A4B ( Gemma Team, 2026 ) and Qwen3.5-35B-A3B ( Qwen Team, 2026 ) .
Both variants converge to a common design with minimal variations in system prompt and output schema.
blocks.zh:
我们接下来优化其四个关键组成部分的设计。
与其手工制作这些设计选择,不如利用代理辅助搜索来修改取用,使基础VLM模型重量被冻结(即没有模型训练).
代理商首先提出修改这四个组件之一的假设,执行相关的代码修改,并使用我们的PAUC-F公尺对BLIP-Live-780K验证集进行评价.
这些结果指导了新假说在多轮和最终设计选择中的产生.
每轮包含10个候选变体,我们推广改进我们目标的变体(PAUC-F关于验证集).
结合互补促进的变化被视为下一轮的新假设。
我们为两个不同的模式进行了10轮提议评价促进周期,每个周期共100个候选人评价: Gemma4-26B-A4B (Gemma Team, 2026)和 Quen3.5-35B-A3B (Quen Team, 2026).
两种变体都趋同为一种共同设计,在系统即时和输出计划上变化最小.

blocks.en:
Given our fixed harness, we perform further model-specific calibration of system prompt and output schema with a more modest compute budget, using the same validation set and PAUC-F metric.
We evaluate five candidates on a fixed 20 sample subset, with each candidate modifying only the system prompt and output schema (joint changes allowed).
This corresponds to 5 rounds (one candidate per round) and a total budget of evaluating 100 video samples.
We perform this limited calibration on all other offline models prior to evaluation.
blocks.zh:
鉴于我们的固定控制装置,我们利用同样的验证装置和PAUC-F 度量衡,对系统即时和输出计划进行进一步的、针对模型的校正,其计算预算较为平缓。
我们用固定的20个样本子集对5名候选人进行评价,每个候选人只修改系统即时和输出计划(允许联合更改)。
这相当于5轮(每轮1名候选人)和评价100个视频样本的总预算。
在评估前,我们在所有其他离线模型上进行这种有限的校准。

blocks.en:
The user query is included in our memory which can be updated midway during a video.
This design choice allows user interaction with the framework mid-video: a human user can pose new queries as the framework continues processing an existing video, further aligning with true streaming setting.
We investigate and evaluate this behavior further in Table 10 .
blocks.zh:
用户查询包含在我们的内存中, 可以在视频中更新。
这种设计选择允许用户与框架的中视频交互:在框架继续处理已存在的视频时,人类用户可以提出新的询问,进一步与真实的流线设置相配合.
我们在表10中进一步调查和评价这种行为。

blocks.en: 5.2 Streaming Model Training
blocks.zh: 5.2 精简示范培训

blocks.en:
We next investigate how supervised finetuning (SFT) can further improve proactivity.
We use streaming data derived from BLIP-Live-780K and construct a training pipeline that retains the efficiency of standard teacher-forced SFT.
An overview of our training formulation is illustrated in Figure 4 .
blocks.zh:
接下来,我们将调查监督的微调(SFT)如何能够进一步提高主动性。
我们使用从BLIP-Live-780K获得的流出数据,并建造一个保留标准教师强制SFT效率的培训管道。
图4概述了我们的培训方案。

blocks.en: 5.2.1 Streaming Episodes and Targets
blocks.zh: 5.2.1 流经和目标

blocks.en:
We construct dense sequences of frame-level decisions from our annotated videos.
First we build full video timelines followed by division into bounded chunks.
A video timeline is a sequence of timestamped frame inputs and model turns, where model turns contain one of three state tokens, </Silence> , </Response> , or </Hold> .
The response token is followed by the annotated natural-language response.
These timelines are split into chunks that contain the memory, absolute timestamps, and its corresponding source-frame range.
Within chunks, all response turns are fully supervised, while long runs of non-response states are subsampled to avoid silence dominating the token budget.
A chunk corresponds to L = 32 L=32 frames, which is the past frame window that is provided to our model.
blocks.zh:
我们从附加说明的视频中 构建了密密的帧级决定序列
首先,我们建立完整的视频时间表,然后划分成有界块。
视频时间轴是时间戳框输入和模型转折的序列,其中模型转折包含三个状态符号中的一个, "/静","回想","或"活".
答复符号后面是附加说明的自然语言答复。
这些时间段被分成块来包含内存,绝对时间戳,以及相应的源框范围.
在块内,所有响应转折都受到充分监督,而一长串非响应状态则被被分取样本来避免沉默主导象征性预算.
一个块对应L=32 L=32帧,这是过去提供给我们的模型的帧窗口.

blocks.en:
Human annotations define three states: irrelevant frames are Silence ; the first frame with sufficient evidence is Response ; subsequent frames of the same ongoing event are Hold , suppressing repetition. Only 18 % 18\% of responses are followed by Hold. Post-response silence-only chunks teach sustained silence. Finetuned models predict all three states at inference; Hold and Silence emit no response and leave memory unchanged. The frozen-model harness uses binary silence/response outputs ( Table A.12 ).
See Appendix F for further details on state targets and our training data distribution.

blocks.en: 5.2.2 Streaming Supervision
blocks.zh: 5.2.2 流动监督

blocks.en:
We perform teacher-forcing SFT by using individual chunks as samples.
Each chunk contains a system prompt, memory, and an interleaved sequence of frame-target pairs.
The targets are the states </Silence> , </Response> , or </Hold> .
blocks.zh:
我们通过使用单个块作为样本来进行教师强制SFT.
每个块都包含一个系统即时,内存,以及帧-目标对的相接序列.

blocks.en: Each training chunk includes the user query and last m = 1 m=1 annotated response; inference uses the model’s last generated response. Memory retains responses outside the visual window to discourage repetition, and new queries can update it mid-video. Both finetuned models use L = 32 L=32 frames and m = 1 m=1 during training and inference. The frozen-model harness uses three frames and m = 1 m=1 ; both settings run at 1 Hz.

blocks.en:
While our training employs a standard next token prediction loss, within each chunk we mask the cross-entropy loss term at token level.
This is motivated by the large portion of silence timestamps inherent to the task and similar strategies in prior work ( Li et al., 2026 ) .
Our token-level loss masking retains all Response targets while subsampling repetitive Silence and Hold continuations. Chunks containing only Silent responses also undergo masking.
The train-time sequence also appends the natural language response after each response token, where the language tokens undergo no loss masking.
blocks.zh:
我们的训练采用了标准的下一个标志性预测损失, 在每个块中,我们掩盖了 跨度性损失术语的标志性水平。
这是因为任务所固有的大量沉默时间戳以及先前工作中的类似策略(Li等,2026年)。
我们的标语级损失掩码保留了所有响应目标,同时对重复性的Silence和Hold continues进行分样. 仅包含静态反应的块也进行口罩.
列车时间序列还附加每个响应符后自然语言响应,其中语言符号不会被丢失的遮掩.

blocks.en: Overall, our inference harness and SFT pipeline share a single streaming interface, and demonstrate how offline VLMs can be adapted to streaming inference eliciting their proactive responsiveness.
blocks.zh: 总体而言,我们的推论利用和SFT管道共享一个单一的流线接口,并展示如何将离线的VLM适应于流线推论,从而引出它们积极主动的反应。

blocks.en:
Figure 4: Streaming Model Training. Each training sequence concatenates a system prompt, memory of user queries / past responses, and an interleaved frame-target stream.
Prompt, memory, and visual tokens receive no loss; the VLM is supervised on state targets (silence, response, and hold) and the accompanying response text. One video is split into multiple chunks so that long streams remain within the training context.

blocks.en: 7 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 7 结论

blocks.en:
Proactive streaming video agents must decide between responding and remaining silent repeatedly for each timestep.
We formulate this task as a series of causal response decisions at each timestep.
Our BLIP-Live framework unifies data, metric, harness, and training around this formulation and demonstrates state-of-the-art performance across four proactive streaming benchmarks.
blocks.zh:
主动流媒体的视频代理商必须决定每一步的反应和反复沉默。
我们把这项任务作为每个阶段的一系列因果反应决定。
我们的BLIP-Live框架统一了数据、计量、利用和培训,并展示了四个主动流线基准的最新业绩。

blocks.en: Appendix B Interactive PO Task
blocks.zh: 附录 B 交互式 PO 任务

blocks.en:
Existing proactive evaluation tasks contain a single query asked at start of the video and their established inference strategy does not involve injecting new queries mid video.
We introduce our PO-I task using the same videos in the PO split of StreamingBench ( Lin et al., 2024 ) , where each video has up to 5 queries injected during the video.
This requires agentic models to handle multiple queries at different times of the videos, introducing several new challenges.
blocks.zh:
现有的主动评价任务包含在视频开始时询问的单一查询,其既定的推断战略不涉及在视频中间注入新的查询.
我们用Streaming Bench(Lin等, 2024年)的PO分机来介绍我们的PO-I任务,
这需要代理模型在不同时间处理多个询问,引入了几个新的挑战.

blocks.en:
We build each PO-I episode from one video in the StreamingBench PO split. The video is streamed once, and its five annotated queries are injected at their original timestamps. We score every query with the same time-accuracy rule as the official PO split.
The key difference lies in the inference setting, which injects queries interleaved with video frames, making the task more difficult.
In these videos, each next query arrives only after the preceding gold response, so PO-I evaluates completed-request updates. The model must switch to the newly injected query while earlier frames and responses remain in context, and must keep later responses specific to that query.
blocks.zh:
我们从Streaming Bench PO拆分的一集中 编织出每个PO -I插曲 视频流出一次,其5个注解的查询会以原来的时间戳注入. 我们的每个查询都得分 与官方PO的分数相同
关键区别在于推论设置,它注入了与视频帧相接的询问,使得任务更加困难.
在这些视频中,每个下个查询只有在之前的黄金回复后才到达,因此PO-I评价完成-请求更新. 该模型必须切换到新注入的查询,而早期的框架和答复则保持上下文,并且必须保留以后针对该查询的答复。

blocks.en:
We note that our training videos do not contain this style of queries mid video.
However, our memory design allows model to condition its behavior on the current memory state.
This is enforced in the harness and training as well.
This allows the model to generalize zero-shot to multi-query interactions during inference, which aligns with positive results we obtain for this task.
blocks.zh:
我们注意到,我们的训练录像没有包含这种询问风格的中段录像。
然而,我们的内存设计允许模型将其行为以当前内存状态作为条件.
这在管理和培训方面也得到了实施。
这使得模型在推论中能够将零射到多克的相互作用概括化,这与我们为这项任务所获得的积极成果是一致的.

blocks.en: C.1 Dataset Generation Details
blocks.zh: C.1 数据集生成细节

blocks.en: For a given video V V , we automatically generate a proactive interaction in two successive model calls.
blocks.zh: 对于一个给定的视频VV, 我们自动生成主动互动 在连续两个模型调用。

blocks.en: First, an instruction-generation model observes the complete video and synthesizes a single video-specific user query q q . The query requests notifications about a concrete and visually verifiable event, action, or state change (e.g., an object being picked up or a person entering the scene). We require each query to define a specific, visually observable trigger, rather than requesting general video narration or relying on subjective criteria such as “interesting” events.
blocks.zh: 首先,一个指令生成模型观测到完整的视频并合成一个单一的视频特定用户查询q q. 查询要求通知具体和可视化可核查的事件、行动或状态变化(例如被取走的物体或进入现场的人)。 我们要求每个查询都界定一个具体的、可视的触发器,而不是要求一般性的视频叙述或依赖“感兴趣的”事件等主观标准。

blocks.en: Next, a response-generation model receives V V and q q and produces a temporally ordered sequence ℛ = { ( t i , r i ) } i = 1 N \mathcal{R}=\{(t_{i},r_{i})\}_{i=1}^{N} , where t i t_{i} is the trigger time and r i r_{i} is a concise natural-language response. To approximate real-time deployment, we instruct the model to emulate an online observer. Although the complete video is provided to the model, we prompt the model and require it to emulate causal streaming observation: each response must rely only on evidence visible up to t i t_{i} , must not anticipate future events, and must be emitted at the first frame at which the query condition is satisfied. This is a prompt-level constraint rather than a restriction on visual access; human reviewers correct responses that precede sufficient visual evidence. The model remains silent between triggers and returns an empty sequence when no valid trigger is detected throughout the video.
blocks.zh: 接下来,一个响应生成模型接收了V V和q q,并产生一个时间顺序R={(ti,ri)}i= 1个 N\ mathcal{R}=\{(t_{i)},r_{i}#\}_{i=1}^{N} (中文(简体) ). ,其中t i t_{i}是触发时间而r i r_{i}是一个简明的自然语言反应. 为了大致实时部署,我们指示该模式效仿在线观察者。 虽然完整的视频被提供给了模型,但我们敦促模型,并要求它模仿因果流派观察:每一次响应必须只依靠能见到t i t_{i}的证据,不能预料到将来的事件,必须在满足查询条件的第一个框架中被放出. 这是一种即时的制约,而不是对视觉访问的限制;人类审查人员在充分视觉证据之前纠正了反应。 该模型在扳机之间保持静默,当整个视频没有检测出有效的扳机时,返回一个空序.

blocks.en: To balance computational cost with the need for fine-grained temporal reasoning, we use different models for the two generation steps. Specifically, we use gemini-3-flash-preview for query generation and gemini-3-pro-preview for response generation. We remove the audio track and sample each video at 1 FPS. Consequently, trigger times are annotated at one-second resolution. The generated queries, responses, timestamps, and associated metadata are stored in structured JSON format and subsequently verified and refined during the human-review stage.
blocks.zh: 为了平衡计算成本和精细的时间推理需要,我们对两代步骤使用不同的模型. 具体来说,我们使用Gemini-3-flash-preview用于查询生成,而Gemini-3-pro-preview用于响应生成. 我们删除了音频轨迹 并取样每个视频 在1 FPS。 因此,一秒钟的决议会说明触发时间。 所产生的询问、答复、时间戳和相关元数据以结构化的JSON格式储存,随后在人审查阶段加以核实和完善。

blocks.en: Human annotators first assess the validity of each generated query. A valid query must specify a concrete and visually recognizable condition that can be detected causally from a streaming video and can therefore support a well-defined response decision. We reject queries whose triggers are ambiguous, subjective, not visually observable, or dependent on future context. Only samples with valid queries proceed to response-level annotation repair.
blocks.zh: 人类的注释者首先评估每个生成的查询的有效性. 一个有效的查询必须指定一个具体和可视识别的条件,可以从流出视频中因果地被检测出,因此可以支持一个定义明确的响应决定. 我们拒绝那些触发因素模糊、主观、不可见或取决于未来背景的询问。 只有有有效查询的样本才进行响应级注解修复.

blocks.en: For each valid query, annotators inspect the timing and content of every generated response and repair the annotations when necessary. A valid response must be relevant to the query, visually grounded at its assigned timestamp, free of hallucinated content, and consistent with causal observation. In particular, the response should be unambiguously supported by the frames observed up to that time, while it may use preceding context but must not reveal information from future frames. Annotators correct inaccurate text, shift temporally misaligned responses, remove spurious responses, and add missed responses as needed.
blocks.zh: 对于每个有效的查询,注释员检查每个生成的回复的时间和内容,并在必要时修复注释. 有效答复必须与查询相关,以指定的时间戳为视线,不包含有幻觉的内容,并与因果观察相一致。 特别是,迄今观察到的框架应毫不含糊地支持该答复,同时可以使用先前的上下文,但不得披露未来框架的信息。 注释者更正了不准确的文字,在时间上转移了错误的响应,删除了虚假的响应,并根据需要添加了错失的响应.

blocks.en: For instantaneous events, the response is generated at the moment when the event becomes visually identifiable. For continuous events that persist over a period of time, annotators additionally enforce semantic continuity across consecutive responses. For example, later responses use expressions such as “continues” or “still” to indicate that the previously observed event remains ongoing.
blocks.zh: 对于即时事件,反应是在事件变得可视化的时刻产生的. 对于持续一段时间的连续事件,注释员在连续的回复中进一步强化语义连续性。 例如,后来的答复使用“持续”或“仍然”等词语来表示以前观察到的事件仍在进行。

blocks.en: Figure A.2: Dataset review interface. Reviewers inspect each sampled video frame against the instruction and existing annotation, navigate temporally, and mark only frames requiring correction. The interface records missing responses, hallucinations, temporal boundary cases, and deletion decisions while automatically treating unmarked frames as correct.
blocks.zh: 图A.2:数据集审查接口。 审查人员对照指示和现有注释检查每个被取样的视频帧,在时间上导航,并只标出需要更正的帧. 界面记录了缺失的响应,幻觉,时间界限等情况,以及删除决定,同时自动将无标记框架视为正确.

blocks.en: Figure A.3: Human rating interface for PAUC-F. Raters inspect the video, ground-truth response regions, and timestamped responses from two anonymized system variants, then select the preferred response stream. The aligned timeline and side-by-side response lists expose differences in event coverage, response timing, and repetitive firing behavior.

blocks.en: A professional video data-annotation team recruits and trains the annotators, who receive detailed instructions and examples before performing annotation repair. We then conduct quality control at the batch level using PhD-level expert reviewers who are independent of the annotation repair process.
blocks.zh: 一个专业的视频数据注释小组招募和培训注释员,他们在进行注释修复前会收到详细的说明和实例. 然后,我们利用独立于注释修复过程的博士级专家审查员进行分批质量控制。

blocks.en: At the beginning of the human annotation process, we partition the automatically generated samples into ten disjoint batches and process them sequentially for human annotation repair. After the annotators complete a batch, independent expert reviewers audit a randomly selected subset of videos and their annotations using a purpose-built web interface. The reviewers examine the complete video timeline. They evaluate the annotation at each one-second time step, treating both the presence and absence of a response as a decision to assess. A response is labeled a true positive if the reviewer confirms that it is warranted and its content is correct, whereas a no-response decision is labeled a true negative if the reviewer agrees that no response is warranted. An unwarranted or incorrect response is labeled a false positive, and a missing response is labeled a false negative.
blocks.zh: 在人类注解过程的开始,我们把自动生成的样品分出为10个分解分批处理,并按顺序处理,进行人类注解修复. 在注释员完成批次后,独立专家审查员利用专门设计的网络界面,对随机选定的一组视频及其说明进行审计。 审查人员审查完整的录像时间表。 他们每一秒钟对说明进行评价,将存在和缺乏答复作为评估决定。 如果审查者确认答复是正当的,其内容是正确的,则将答复贴上真实正面的标签;如果审查者同意不需要答复,则将不答复决定贴上真实正面的标签。 无正当理由或不正确反应被贴上虚假正反标签,缺失反应被贴上虚假正反标签.

We quantify annotation quality using the F1 metric. A batch is accepted, and annotation proceeds to the next batch, only if F ​ 1 > 0.95 F1>0.95 .
Batches that do not meet this threshold undergo further correction and review. During the initial batches, we have repeated the cycle of annotator training, annotation, and independent evaluation multiple times to calibrate the annotation criteria and establish consistent quality before processing the remaining batches.

我们用F1度量法量化注释质量。 只有在F 1 > 0.95 F1 > 0.95的情况下,才接受批次,并进行下批次的说明。
不符合这一阈值的蝙蝠须作进一步的更正和审查。 在最初批次中,我们多次重复了批注培训、批注和独立评审的周期,以校准批注标准,并在处理其余批次之前确定一致的质量。

blocks.en: We use the purpose-built interface shown in Figure A.2 for frame-level review of the generated annotations. Reviewers step through the video at one-second intervals and flag problematic frames as missing, hallucinated, boundary cases, or incorrect deletion decisions. Unmarked frames are recorded as correct when the reviewer completes the video, enabling efficient and consistent auditing of both responses and silence decisions.

blocks.en: Our PAUC-F metric is simply the harmonic mean between two established components, the PAUC metric from Wang et al. (2025b) and firing precision. We justify our use of the harmonic mean with two key reasons.
blocks.zh: 我们的PAUC-F度量衡只是两个既定组件(由Wang等人提供的PAUC度量衡(2025年b)和发射精度)之间的调谐平均值。 我们以两个关键理由证明我们使用口琴手段是合理的。

blocks.en:
First, the harmonic mean is the strictly correct operator for calculating the true average of rates or ratios ( Yule and Kendall, 1947 ; Ferger, 1931 ) .
In our case, both PAUC and Firing Precision represent rates of success.
PAUC is the rate of accumulated quality-score over a bounded temporal window, while Firing Precision is the rate of valid fires over total fires.
blocks.zh:
首先,口琴指由严格正确的操作者来计算费率或比率的真实平均值(Yule and Kendall,1947;Ferger,1931.).
就我们而言,PAUC和FIRING精准度都是成功率。
PAUC是限时窗口上积分质量分数的速率,而发火精度是有效起火率高于总起火.

blocks.en:
Second, from an optimization perspective, the harmonic mean severely penalizes high variance between its inputs ( Van Rijsbergen, 1979 ) .
For streaming video agents, timeliness (PAUC) and firing restraint (Precision) are competing objectives; a model can easily maximize PAUC by spamming responses, driving Precision near zero.
An arithmetic or geometric mean allows linear or proportional substitutability, allowing the model to hide terrible precision behind a perfect PAUC.
The harmonic mean enforces that the marginal utility of maximizing PAUC drops to zero if Precision is sacrificed, mathematically guaranteeing that a high PAUC-F strictly requires Pareto-optimal balance between the two.
This also mirrors the theoretical foundation of the F1 score in information retrieval.
blocks.zh:
第二,从优化的角度来看,口琴意味着严重惩罚其投入之间的高度差异(Van Rijsbergen,1979年)。
对于流线视频代理,及时性(PAUC)和射击约束(Plecent)是相竞的目标;一个模型可以很容易地通过闪烁回击来使PAUC最大化,驱动Precent接近于零.
一个算术或几何平均值允许线性或比例的可替代性,允许模型将可怕的精度隐藏在完美的PAUC后.
口琴指强制说,如果牺牲精度,最大化PAUC的边际效用会降至零,数学上保证高的PAUC-F严格要求两者的Pareto-优化平衡.
这也反映了F1分数在信息检索中的理论基础.

Table A.16 presents the shared system instruction used for supervised finetuning and inference with BLIP-Live-Gemma and BLIP-Live-Qwen. These models predict </Silence> , </Response> , or </Hold> . Only </Response> produces a user-facing answer and updates response memory; Silence and Hold produce no answer and leave memory unchanged. Hold distinguishes an ongoing, already-reported event from irrelevant frames labeled Silence. Both training and inference use up to 32 frames and the last response as memory, at a 1 Hz decision rate.
